lines.zh: 我挂在叶柄上，随风轻摆
lines.en: I hang from the leaf stem, swaying.
I cannot walk; I can only sway.
One thread holds me beneath the leaf.
The jungle wind sets me rocking.
The leaf veins ridge beneath my back.
I turn gently against the leaf face.
Rain strikes; I tip a little.

lines.zh: 壳里的身体在慢慢重排
lines.en: Inside the shell my body is rearranging.

lines.zh: 日光从叶隙落在我身上
lines.en: Sunlight falls through the leaves onto me.
I sink a little lower.
The branch bends, and I dip with it.
I hang below the leaf, almost still.
A grey shell in the shade.
The twig moves; so do I.
I hang in air, feet nowhere.
I wait for the sun to change angle.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，什么也看不见
lines.en: Inside the shell, I see nothing.

lines.zh: 灰白的壳和树皮一个颜色
lines.en: My pale grey shell matches the bark.

lines.zh: 我等着里面的变化结束
lines.en: I wait for the change inside to finish.
The leaf underside is cool.
A fine seam runs along my shell.
Time means little to me.
I hear footsteps below the tree.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，也不需要喝
lines.en: I need neither food nor water.
Now and then something moves inside.

lines.zh: 我挂在最高的那片叶下
lines.en: I hang beneath the highest leaf.
Dew runs down the leaf tip and falls.

lines.zh: 我只剩下等待这一件事
lines.en: Waiting is all I have left to do.
I see you look up from under my leaf.
You have found me.
I hang within your line of sight.
You reach out; I sway.
A pale grey shell is not conspicuous.

lines.zh: 你的鼻尖离我的蛹壳很近。
lines.en: Your nose is very close to my pupal shell.
You cannot tell what is inside.
Do not touch me with your hand.
I am not ready yet.
Will you wait until I come out?
A mark is pressed into the shell.
I swing violently.
My thread has loosened.
The body inside contracts.
It hurts, and I cannot cry out.

lines.zh: 这片叶子晃了整整一阵
lines.en: The leaf shakes for a long while.
I nearly shook loose.
A patch of my shell has darkened.
I can only endure it.
Please go away.

lines.zh: 蛹壳封着，食物对我无用。
lines.en: Sealed in this shell, food means nothing to me.
You hold it up beneath the leaf.
The shell is sealed.
That is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 等我羽化出来，再来谈吃。
lines.en: Wait until I emerge, then we can talk about eating.
I cannot even use a mouth.
Nectar? That comes later.

lines.zh: 我听见你晃瓶子，可我不动。
lines.en: I hear you rattle the bottle, but I do not move.
Is that nectar you are holding up?
I have no use for these now.

lines.zh: 叶子被你碰得一沉，我贴紧它。
lines.en: The leaf dips under your touch, and I press myself against it.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶柄，我晃得厉害。
lines.en: You touched the stem, and I am swinging hard.
My thread pulls taut.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我差点脱开叶柄。
lines.en: The leaf lurches and I nearly tear loose from its stem.

lines.zh: 风把叶子推开，我又回来
lines.en: The wind pushes the leaf; I swing back.
Your head meets the leaf's underside.
I press close to the leaf.
That turned me to face another way.
The water on the leaf spills off.
Once more and I will fall.

lines.zh: 我还没成形，谈不了这些
lines.en: I am not formed yet; I cannot speak of this.
After I emerge.
There is only me inside this shell.
Others of my kind are on other leaves.
We find each other by scent.
For now I only want quiet.
My wings have not grown yet.
There will be another time.
You ask too early.
I do not yet know myself.

lines.zh: 我连足都缩在壳里，别指望。
lines.en: Even my legs are drawn into the shell; do not count on me.
It is just below me.
I cannot reach it.
The leaf dips; I sway.
You take it for me.
That has nothing to do with me.
I watched it drop.
Let the wind blow it up.
It hangs on the branch, noticeable.

lines.zh: 我被壳裹着，连足都动不了。
lines.en: Wrapped in this shell, I cannot even move my legs.
You have stood under the tree too long.
I cannot move, but I see.
You looked up.
I am directly above your head.
Perhaps you will wait for me to emerge.
I cannot flee, and have no need to.

lines.zh: 这片叶背的位置正合我意。
lines.en: This spot on the underside of the leaf suits me perfectly.
Do not poke me with that stick.

lines.zh: 淡灰的壳吊着，我们慢慢耗。
lines.en: My pale gray shell hangs there; we can wait each other out.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是挂在叶下。
lines.en: I do nothing at all; I simply hang beneath the leaf.
I have stayed beneath the leaf.
You have passed three times.
The wind turned the leaf.
I can see the top of your head.

lines.zh: 我颜色淡，混在树影里了。
lines.en: My color is pale; I blend into the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 灰白的东西在绿叶上不明显
lines.en: Pale grey hides well on green.
I am high above the ground.
Looking up will not help.
I wait; I am not hurried.
I chose this tree carefully.
I have no way to attack.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，也只是晃一下
lines.en: Touch me and I only sway.
The shell is hard, but no weapon.
I cannot pin anyone down.
I slipped on the leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下让你碰到了露水
lines.en: That got dew on you.

lines.zh: 我唯一能做的就是等风
lines.en: I can only wait for wind.
How did you find me?

lines.zh: 我连晃一下蛹壳都费劲。
lines.en: I can barely even rock my pupal shell.
Do as you like.
The caterpillar chose this leaf.
Here I became a shell.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶柄最结实的地方
lines.en: I hang where the leaf stem is firmest.
The pale grey color suits the place.
One thread holds me fast.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次这样挂着
lines.en: This is the first time I hang like this.
Sunlight slants between the leaves.
There are other chrysalises nearby.
I am beginning to change.
The jungle smells strong.
The leaf curls before the fire even reaches.
I fell from the leaf.
Water soaks me through.
The blast tears the leaf.
Something pierces the shell.

lines.zh: 那力量让我里面的身体乱动
lines.en: That force scrambles the body inside.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，不吃也不会饿死
lines.en: Inside the shell, I do not starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整片壳都麻了
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree; my whole shell numbs.
The leaf is gone, and I fall.
